title: Stream transcript (invalid): DATA_WRITE before SESSION_INIT
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with a DATA_WRITE filesystem entry on a nonzero Stream ID before any SESSION_INIT has been received. Stateful Streaming Mode requires a valid SESSION_INIT to be processed before accepting filesystem entries for a stream. Must be rejected with SAR_ERR_STREAM_STATE.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
The bytes are structurally valid SAR; the violation is at the session-semantics level.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
